name: route-animator
summary: Flies a route over a satellite globe and records the video in the browser

shot.alt: A Madison to Reykjavik to Paris flight drawn on the satellite globe in Route Animator

hook: The paid route-video makers want an account, a watermark and an export limit. This one is a single HTML file.
built: MapLibre GL, Canvas 2D, in-browser video capture

pages.extra: In blue, the route in the screenshot: Madison, Reykjavík, Paris

pages.title: How it works
notes: Flies a vehicle along a multi-stop route over a satellite globe and records it with MediaRecorder. No server ever sees the clip.
Every vehicle is drawn top-down on canvas, because emoji are three-quarter views and read wrong from directly overhead.
Altitude follows leg-local time rather than distance; keying it to distance let the climb eat a third of the flight.
pages.caption: Altitude over one flying leg, plotted from route-animator’s own altOf(). Keyed to eased distance, the plane sits on the runway until 18% of the leg and is still climbing at 38%.

blurb: satellite-globe route videos in the browser
